caption: Capacity and regularization: We vary capacity (via network width) and regulariza- tion (via dropout) on one environment from each task suite. Larger networks perform better on hopper-medium-expert and kitchen-complete, suggesting the importance of high-capacity pol- icy networks. However, dropout also usually boosts performance in kitchen-complete, suggesting that a combination of high-capacity policies with effective regularization is important for achieving good results.
